look.summary_zh: 中性 · 压暗中灰 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 120.8/255（变化 -6.7 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.136。中灰红减蓝 -2.5 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F1DBC9、#D39471、#793E29；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #B00810、#63DE1B、#0930AA。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 120.8/255 (-6.7 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.136; mid-gray red minus blue -2.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F1DBC9, #D39471, #793E29. Red/green/blue swatches: #B00810, #63DE1B, #0930AA.
look.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
